LESSON: INDIGENOUS KENYAN GAMES (OPTIONAL)

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.6: Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)
2. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) in the examples.
2. Explain Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)
2. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
